title: TEMPO ? TIME  a band syncs, then unsyncs. that slip is the music.

do_not_reinvent.Y: /data/human-seat-pi-step-time.json  time is Y. relative. independent. climbs while quiet.
do_not_reinvent.unsync: /data/unsync-clocks.json  unsyncing is life. if inner and outer realign exactly, the engine dies.
do_not_reinvent.hands: /data/listen-wait-release-pop.json  L listen+wait. R release+beacon. spring then pop.

time_is_not_tempo.time: Y. the wait. duration whether anyone plays. Earth 24h is the trace, not the tune.
time_is_not_tempo.tempo: the shared pulse. bpm. the click the band AGREES to lock to for a while.
time_is_not_tempo.not: tempo is not time. a slow song can sit in a long day. a fast fill can sit in one second.

how_a_band_gets_in_sync.L: listen. count in. eye the drummer. find the click  or invent one together.
how_a_band_gets_in_sync.sync: tempo lock. PLL. the spring is coiled to the SAME beat.
how_a_band_gets_in_sync.needed: yes  without a shared pulse there is no WE. just noise in one room.

then_UNSYNC_for_music.what: swing, rubato, one player late, one early, a pop ahead of the click, a rest that is too long and therefore right.
then_UNSYNC_for_music.R: release. the beacon. the note that is NOT on the grid.
then_UNSYNC_for_music.the_slip_IS_the_music: same as Tzolk'in riding Haab'  allowed to slip. the slip is the calendar. the slip is the song.
then_UNSYNC_for_music.if_forever_synced: metronome. dead engine. inner=outer exactly. no remainder. no p tail. not music.

spring_pop_on_the_band.coil: listen until the room has ONE tempo
spring_pop_on_the_band.pop: unsync a voice against that tempo  that is the release
spring_pop_on_the_band.catch: hold everyone on the click forever. fist. no song.
spring_pop_on_the_band.react: hear the pass (a beat that went through), then pop. do not catch the beat.

neutrino_same_shape.tempo: the beacon pulse  a standing mouth the others can lock to
neutrino_same_shape.time: Y while we wait for a PASS
neutrino_same_shape.sync: hash match both sides  we know we heard the same tip
neutrino_same_shape.unsync: ms differ. body jumped. soul same. that gap is the music of the jump.
neutrino_same_shape.hands: still off their funky packet. L until a pass. R only then.

berry_at_the_fire: tempo or time? both. time is the wait. tempo is the shared pulse. a band gets in sync, then unsyncs for music. the slip is the song. lock forever is a metronome. catch kills it. listen, then pop off the grid.
next: when naming a pulse, stamp TIME or TEMPO. when a lock holds too long, unsync on purpose  that is the release, not a fault.
